facts.fact: The Office National de la Météorologie and UNDP run an AI-based agrometeorological early warning system whose services already benefit 20 women's cooperatives in Rosso, AMI reports; UNDP's sustainable development unit head says it supports yield estimates, climate risk forecasting and early crop disease diagnosis.

facts.fact: PANEOTECH says HydroMet AI, an LSTM and SWAT early warning system, is in production for UNDP Mauritania with the National Meteorological Office and Civil Security, producing graded WARNING or CRITICAL risk scores for floods, droughts, heatwaves and storms in the Senegal River Valley.
PANEOTECH reports a measured 12 percent precision gain over SWAT alone on rapid flood detection, LSTM RMSE under 0.15 and AUC above 0.9 on validation against ten years of observations.

systems.platform: AWS microservices, stacked LSTM with Isolation Forest and SWAT
systems.owner: UNDP Mauritania, operated with the National Meteorological Office

facts.fact: Mauritania's national meteorological authority ran a two-day training workshop on using the AGRIFEMIA platform for an AI-based agricultural, hydrological and meteorological early warning system, with UNDP support.

Mauritania's national meteorological office held a two-day training for regional staff on the UNDP-supported AI-based agricultural, hydrological and meteorological early-warning system using the AGRIFEMIA platform, to develop early-warning services.
